event.title: Passenger Ferry Capsizes Off Guyana, Search and Rescue Underway
event.canonical_title: Passenger Ferry Capsizes Off Guyana, Search and Rescue Underway
event.summary: A passenger ferry carrying 116 people capsized off the coast of Guyana, prompting a search and rescue operation. Authorities reported that 53 individuals have been rescued so far, while efforts continue to locate the remaining passengers and crew. The incident occurred between Georgetown and Port Kaituma, with a distress call made shortly after 11 PM local time.

The incident occurred between Georgetown and Port Kaituma, with a distress call made shortly after 11 PM local time.
